Punch List

description: Core links Quality Review and Quality Feedback but not NCR — a genuine gap.
label: Non Conformance
name: Quality Action-custom_non_conformance

description: Not named custom_owner: too close to the framework's own `owner` column to be worth the confusion.
label: Owner
name: Quality Action-custom_assigned_to

description: A punch item IS a Quality Action with this ticked — it inherits carry-forward and two-step closure rather than living in a spreadsheet.
label: Punch list item
name: Quality Action-custom_punch_list

description: The inspection that will re-check this fix. Claimed in sub-phase F.
label: Verified at
name: Quality Action-custom_verifying_inspection

description: A project goal may only meet or exceed the company-wide target for the same measure. Enforcement is set in Quality Settings.
label: Goal type
name: Quality Goal-custom_goal_type

description: Free text, for grouping goals on a review or a meeting agenda.
label: Category
name: Quality Goal-custom_category

description: ERPNext's own scheduler has no Annual branch, so this cadence is driven by this app. The day comes from the Date field above.
label: Annual review month
name: Quality Goal-custom_annual_month
options:
January
February
March
April
May
June
July
August
September
October
November
December

description: Which measure this objective is scored against. first_pass_yield = first-pass yield; inspection_fail_count = failed checks; ncrs_raised = non-conformances raised; critical_ncrs = critical non-conformances; open_punch_items = open punch-list items; actions_reopened = fixes that failed re-verification; avg_days_to_close_action = average days to close an action
label: Measured by
name: Quality Goal Objective-custom_metric
options:
first_pass_yield
inspection_fail_count
ncrs_raised
critical_ncrs
open_punch_items
actions_reopened
avg_days_to_close_action

description: Copied from the goal. A project review reports only that project's work.
label: Project
name: Quality Review-custom_project

description: The period ends the day BEFORE the review was generated, so a review reports the interval that finished rather than one a day old.
label: Period end
name: Quality Review-custom_period_end

description: What could and could not be worked out, and why.
label: Computation summary
name: Quality Review-custom_summary

description: How much activity the number was computed over. A sample of zero means the period is undecidable, not perfect.
label: Sample
name: Quality Review Objective-custom_sample_size

description: Stamped when a re-inspection closes the action. Without it, days-to-close could only be guessed from the modified timestamp, which any edit moves.
label: Closed on
name: Quality Action-custom_closed_on

description: The Master Subcontractor Agreement this order is placed under. Required when the supplier has one — an order outside the agreement is an order at rates nobody agreed.
label: Master agreement
name: Purchase Order-custom_msa_contract

description: Set when this order exists because of a change order rather than the original scope. Without it, change-order cost cannot be traced to what was actually bought.
label: Change order
name: Purchase Order-custom_change_order

label: Budget by Category Intro
name: Project-custom_budget_lines_intro
options: Split the project budget into categories here. Once there is at least one line, the Estimated Costing field below is their sum and is maintained automatically — so filling these in also produces the project total rather than being a second thing to keep in step. Committed and Actual are computed from what each category declares as its source, and the Coverage column says whether the Actual figure beside it means anything. Money moves between categories on a Budget Reallocation, not by editing two lines.

description: Which budget category this line spends against. Optional — a line without one is reported as unclassified project spend rather than being pushed into a category nobody chose.
label: Budget Category
name: Purchase Order Item-custom_budget_category

description: The latest scorecard's headline, carried here as a SENTENCE rather than a number. A supplier row showing a bare 0 with nothing saying whether anything was measurable is exactly the misreading the scorecard exists to prevent.
label: Latest scorecard
name: Supplier-custom_scorecard_summary

description: Whether we sought the cost of this failure back from the subcontractor, and how far that got. Kept on the non-conformance rather than on a separate claim record so what went wrong and what we recovered stay on one document -- the traceability this programme is built on.
label: Recovery status
name: Non Conformance-custom_recovery_status
options:
Not Sought
Claimed
Agreed
Recovered
Written Off
Disputed

description: What we asked back. The scorecard's recovery rate is unanswerable rather than zero when nothing was claimed, which is the ordinary case.
label: Claimed
name: Non Conformance-custom_recovery_claimed

description: Effective-dated. The row whose Effective From is the latest date on or before the day worked is the rate in force. Visible only to HR Manager, Accounts Manager and System Manager.
label: Pay Rates
name: Employee-custom_pay_rates

description: The Time Kiosk clock-in session this line was synced from. Written by api.time_kiosk.sync_interval_to_timesheet; an approved correction finds and rewrites the line by it.
label: Job Interval
name: Timesheet Detail-custom_job_interval

description: Used by the Time Kiosk for the off-site check and the map when the project has no Maintenance Profile coordinates and its Address is not geocoded. Filled by geocoding the project address (workforce/sites.py) or typed in with Source = Manual.
label: Site Latitude
name: Project-custom_site_latitude

description: Geocoded = filled from the address by the app and re-geocoded when the address changes. Manual = typed in and left alone.
label: Site Location Source
name: Project-custom_site_location_source

description: The address text the coordinates were geocoded from.
label: Geocoded From
name: Project-custom_site_geocoded_from
